cueCard.explain: and explain why you enjoy it.

questions.text: Describe a sport or physical activity that you enjoy.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a sport or physical activity that you enjoy. You should say: what the activity is; when you started doing it; who you do it with; and explain why you enjoy it.

questions.text: Would you encourage other people to try this activity?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you encourage other people to try this activity?

questions.text: Why do many adults stop doing sport as they get older?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a sport or physical activity you enjoy, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all sport and health. Why do many adults stop doing sport as they get older?
